sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bosses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "defeat_meaning" TEXT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempt_number" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "reset_on_fail" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pinned" IN (0, 1)), "target_date" TEXT NULL, "last_fought_at" TEXT NULL, "open_from_attempt" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "defeated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "phases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "boss_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bosses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "open_from_attempt" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "boss_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bosses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "phase_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES phases (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recurrence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_split" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_split" IN (0, 1)), "daily_deadline_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attempts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "boss_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bosses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "task_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "boss_attempt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "outcome" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cause" INTEGER NULL, "phase_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES phases (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "lesson" TEXT NULL, "weight" INTEGER NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_resolved_day" TEXT NULL, "onboarded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("onboarded" IN (0, 1)), "biome" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_logs" ("day" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lesson" TEXT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("day", "kind"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ember_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "boss_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES bosses (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commitments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "boss_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bosses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "deadline" TEXT NOT NULL, "extensions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remind" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remind" IN (0, 1)), "outcome" INTEGER NULL, "resolved_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("task_id", "day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" INTEGER NOT NULL, "commitment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES commitments (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "relics" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "boss_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES bosses (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "emblem" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effort" INTEGER NOT NULL, "story" TEXT NOT NULL, "inscription" TEXT NULL, "defeated_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("boss_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visits" ("day" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("day"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "signal_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "tap_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("tap_mode" IN (0, 1)), "default_reset_on_fail" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "haptics" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("haptics" IN (0, 1)), "rollover_hour" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "reminder_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reminder_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "reminder_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1260, "first_day" TEXT NULL, "sound" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sound" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flask_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" INTEGER NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bloodstains" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "boss_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bosses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "task_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "attempt_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES attempts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "recovered_at" TEXT NULL, "lost_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "tbl" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" INTEGER NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rejected_reason" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_plans" ("day" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "applying" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("applying" IN (0, 1)), "account_email" TEXT NULL, "last_account_id" TEXT NULL, "session_ended" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("session_ended" IN (0, 1)), "merge_notice_shown" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("merge_notice_shown" IN (0, 1)), "last_app_version" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
